rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who drives a vehicle.

example.traditional: 個司機揸車揸得好穩陣。
example.jyutping: go3 si1 gei1 zaa1 ce1 zaa1 dak1 hou2 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this technical term for software that lets an application communicate with hardware.

example.english: Once you install a new driver on your computer, the printer works normally.
example.traditional: 你部電腦裝咗個新驅動程式，部打印機就正常喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 bou6 din6 nou5 zong1 zo2 go3 san1 keoi1 dung6 cing4 sik1 bou6 daa2 jan3 gei1 zau6 zing3 soeng4 laa3
